style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 4 Santa Christmas Tree Bows Decorations
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Capture the traditional spirit of Christmas with these Santa-inspired decorative bows. Crafted from plush oxblood velvet and trimmed with soft white faux fur, these padded bows bring a sense of luxury and cosiness to any display. Whether used on a tree, a wreath, or as a finishing touch for gift wrapping, they provide a classic and heartwarming accent that enhances any seasonal setting.</p><ul><li>Bow-shaped hanging decoration in oxblood red&nbsp;<br></li><li>Dimensions approx. 15 cm height, 11 cm length, 3 cm width&nbsp;<br></li><li>Material: polyester velvet with white faux fur trim&nbsp;</li><li>Lightweight and easy to hang on tree, wreath, or door&nbsp;<br></li><li>Perfect for creating a warm, classic Christmas atmosphere</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This decorative bow is designed for quick and festive Christmas styling on trees, wreaths, doors, or gift wrappings. The plush oxblood red velvet and soft white faux edging create a classic Santa-inspired look that instantly adds warmth and coziness to any seasonal display. The bow shape is softly padded for a full, luxurious appearance and comes with an integrated hanging ribbon for effortless placement on branches, hooks, or handles. Ideal as a small eye-catcher, it combines rich colour with a soft texture to enhance traditional and modern Christmas themes alike. Bow-shaped hanging decoration in oxblood red.
